answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can require every new identity to lock a scarce, slashable bond before earning reputation or voting. The required words are comet garden nebula and can label independent identity cohorts, but each fake identity still needs its own bond. An attacker creating 1,000 identities therefore ties up 1,000 bonds and risks losing them for coordinated abuse, paying capital and opportunity cost while honest agents recover theirs by behaving correctly.
